description: This file implements classes and methods for managing Dobby containers within the WPEFramework, including container creation, starting, stopping, and information retrieval, as well as IPC service setup and event handling.

classes.name: DobbyContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing Dobby container lifecycle, IPC service, and proxy interactions.

classes.name: DobbyContainer
classes.description: Represents a Dobby container, providing methods to start, stop, and retrieve container info.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DobbyContainerAdministrator.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on configuration files found in search paths.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Configures logging options for containers (stub implementation).

methods.name: DestroyContainer
methods.description: Stops and removes a container by name.

methods.name: ContainerNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a container with the given name is already running.

methods.name: containerStopCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops, used to fulfill stop promises.
